title: Landmark haiku: additions to japanese-texts.json
note: Haiku about the game's landmarks (docs/landmarks.md), appended to japanese-texts.json at build time. Same entry shape and source keys; ids follow the same convention (Parsoid element ids on the Wikisource page).

basho.title: 芭蕉俳句全集 (Bashō Haiku Collection, 1902 edition)
basho.credit: Matsuo Bashō. Japanese transcription by Japanese Wikisource contributors.
basho.english_credit: New English translations for this collection, by Claude

entries.japanese: 皆拜め二見の七五三を年の暮
entries.english:
All of you, bow
to Futami's sacred rope
at the year's end
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 尊さに皆おし合ひぬ御遷宮
entries.english:
Such holiness
everyone pressing and jostling
at the shrine's renewal
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 初雪やいつ大佛の柱立
entries.english:
First snow
when will they raise the pillars
for the Great Buddha?
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: あら尊と靑葉若葉の日の光
entries.english:
How holy
on green leaves, young leaves
the light of the sun
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.english:
Arashiyama
the wind draws its lines
through the thick bamboo
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 霧時雨富士を見ぬ日ぞ面白き
entries.english:
Misty rain
a day with no Fuji in sight
has its own delight
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: よし野にて櫻見せうぞ檜木笠
entries.english:
At Yoshino
I'll show you the cherry blossoms
my cypress hat
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 父母のしきりに戀し雉子の聲
entries.english:
How I long
for my father and mother
a pheasant's cry
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō

entries.japanese: 箱根越す人もあるらし今朝の雪
entries.english:
Someone must be crossing
the Hakone pass
in this morning's snow
entries.author: Matsuo Bashō
